es.summary: La atorvastatina es un inhibidor de la HMG‑CoA reductasa usado para disminuir los niveles de colesterol LDL y reducir el riesgo cardiovascular.
key_points: Inhibe la síntesis hepática de colesterol y aumenta receptores LDL
Se usa para prevención primaria y secundaria de enfermedad cardiovascular
Monitorear enzimas hepáticas y CK antes y durante el tratamiento
Riesgo de miopatía y rabdomiólisis, mayor con fármacos que inhiben CYP3A4
Evitar pomelo y suspender antes de cirugías mayores

mechanism: Bloquea la HMG‑CoA reductasa, paso limitante de la síntesis de colesterol
Disminuye la producción de colesterol VLDL en el hígado
Aumenta la expresión de receptores LDL en hepatocitos, favoreciendo la captación de LDL‑C
indications: Prevención primaria en adultos con múltiples factores de riesgo cardiovascular
Prevención secundaria tras infarto de miocardio, accidente cerebrovascular o revascularización
Diabetes tipo 2 con riesgo cardiovascular elevado
contraindications: Enfermedad hepática activa o cirrosis descompensada
Hipersenibilidad a la atorvastatina o a sus excipientes
adverse_effects: Dolor muscular, debilidad y elevación de CK (comunes)
Hepatitis o elevación de AST/ALT >3 × ULN (serio)
Rabdomiólisis con CK >10 × ULN, insuficiencia renal aguda (serio)
interactions: Inhibidores potentes de CYP3A4 (ej. claritromicina, itraconazol) aumentan niveles y toxicidad
Fibratos y niacina aumentan riesgo de miopatía
Ciclosporina y gemfibrozilo potencian toxicidad muscular
Jugo de pomelo incrementa exposición sistémica
nursing_care: Obtener historial de enfermedad hepática, uso de fibratos o niacina, y antecedentes de miopatía
Obtener valores basales de AST, ALT y CK antes de iniciar
Monitorear AST/ALT cada 12 semanas; suspender si >3 × ULN
Evaluar dolor muscular, debilidad o cambios en orina; medir CK si aparecen síntomas
Retener dosis y notificar al médico si CK >10 × ULN o síntomas graves
patient_teaching: Tomar la tableta a la misma hora cada día, con o sin alimentos
No interrumpir el tratamiento sin consultar al profesional de salud
Evitar jugo de pomelo y alimentos ricos en grasa saturada
Reportar dolor muscular intenso, debilidad, orina oscura o ictericia
Mantener dieta baja en colesterol y asistir a controles de lípidos

outcomes: AST/ALT ≤ 3 × ULN en controles de laboratorio
Lípidos séricos dentro de metas terapéuticas establecidas

interventions.action: Obtener y registrar valores basales de AST, ALT y CK antes de iniciar la terapia
interventions.rationale: Permite detectar alteraciones hepáticas o musculares preexistentes

interventions.action: Monitorear enzimas hepáticas cada 12 semanas y CK si aparecen síntomas musculares
interventions.rationale: Detecta toxicidad temprana y previene complicaciones graves

interventions.action: Evaluar diariamente dolor muscular, debilidad o cambios en la orina
interventions.rationale: Identifica signos de miopatía o rabdomiólisis para intervención oportuna

interventions.action: Retener la dosis y notificar al médico si AST/ALT >3 × ULN o CK >10 × ULN
interventions.rationale: Previene daño hepático o muscular grave

interventions.action: Educar al paciente sobre la importancia de reportar síntomas musculares y evitar jugo de pomelo
interventions.rationale: Facilita la detección precoz de efectos adversos y reduce interacciones

en.summary: Atorvastatin is an HMG‑CoA reductase inhibitor used to lower LDL cholesterol levels and reduce cardiovascular risk.
key_points: Inhibits hepatic cholesterol synthesis and increases LDL receptors
Used for primary and secondary prevention of cardiovascular disease
Monitor liver enzymes and CK before and during therapy
Risk of myopathy and rhabdomyolysis, higher with CYP3A4 inhibitors
Avoid grapefruit and discontinue before major surgeries

mechanism: Blocks HMG‑CoA reductase, the rate‑limiting step in cholesterol synthesis
Reduces VLDL production in the liver
Increases LDL receptor expression on hepatocytes, enhancing LDL‑C clearance
indications: Primary prevention in adults with multiple cardiovascular risk factors
Secondary prevention after myocardial infarction, stroke, or revascularization
Type 2 diabetes with high cardiovascular risk
contraindications: Active liver disease or decompensated cirrhosis
Hypersensitivity to atorvastatin or its excipients
adverse_effects: Muscle pain, weakness, and CK elevation (common)
Rhabdomyolysis with CK >10 × ULN, acute renal failure (serious)
interactions: Strong CYP3A4 inhibitors (e.g., clarithromycin, itraconazole) increase levels and toxicity
Fibrates and niacin increase myopathy risk
Cyclosporine and gemfibrozil potentiate muscle toxicity
nursing_care: Obtain history of liver disease, fibrate or niacin use, and prior myopathy
Obtain baseline AST, ALT, and CK before starting
Monitor AST/ALT every 12 weeks; discontinue if >3 × ULN
Assess for muscle pain, weakness, or changes in urine; check CK if symptoms appear
Hold dose and notify provider if CK >10 × ULN or severe symptoms
patient_teaching: Take the tablet at the same time each day, with or without food
Do not discontinue therapy without consulting a healthcare professional
Avoid grapefruit juice and foods high in saturated fat
Report intense muscle pain, weakness, dark urine, or jaundice
Maintain a low‑cholesterol diet and attend lipid monitoring appointments

outcomes: Serum lipids within established therapeutic goals

interventions.action: Obtain and record baseline AST, ALT, and CK before initiating therapy
interventions.rationale: Detect preexisting hepatic or muscular abnormalities

interventions.action: Monitor liver enzymes every 12 weeks and CK if muscular symptoms arise
interventions.rationale: Identify early toxicity and prevent serious complications

interventions.action: Assess daily for muscle pain, weakness, or urine changes
interventions.rationale: Detect signs of myopathy or rhabdomyolysis for timely intervention

interventions.action: Hold dose and notify provider if AST/ALT >3 × ULN or CK >10 × ULN
interventions.rationale: Prevent severe hepatic or muscular damage

interventions.action: Educate patient on importance of reporting muscular symptoms and avoiding grapefruit juice
interventions.rationale: Facilitate early detection of adverse effects and reduce interactions
